body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Cydle, an emerging leader in mobile consumer electronics, announced it will unveil the newest addition to the company's extensive line of multimedia products, the i30A Mobile TV Receiver for the iPhone at the 2011 International CES.

Cydle's i30A Mobile TV Receiver brings Mobile TV directly to a variety of Smartphones, specifically the iPhone. Featuring ATSC Mobile Digital TV and Smart Battery charging and sharing, the i30A features a built-in retractable antenna, built-in speakers, and is also equipped with an enclosed mounting kit. Furthermore, the mobile TV receiver requires no subscription or additional fees to access mobile TV.

"As often as people are on the go, many would enjoy the option to access TV anywhere at anytime," stated Terry Choi, director of sales, Cydle. "Cydle strives to provide products that will meet and surpass the needs of consumers, and we're confident that the i30A will enhance the entertainment experience like no other."

Cydle is among the first to develop this type of ATSC M/H DTV receiver for the iPhone and has an international patent for this technology and design. Cydle's i30A Mobile TV Receiver will be available at major retailers nationwide in March 2011, with a starting MSRP of $149.
